# Fixture log for the nightly tracking-issue reporter — NOT a real sweep.
#
# Fed to .github/scripts/nightly_report.py by the nightly workflow's
# `report_fixture` dispatch input, so the issue open/update/close path can be
# exercised on demand without rendering 500 cartridges. The three slugs below
# are deliberately fake (`fixture-*`): no cartridge in this repo is named that,
# so an issue raised from this file can never be mistaken for a real failure.
#
# The three lines cover the three shapes the parser has to get right:
#   1. mode + part + engine, no preset
#   2. mode + part + preset + engine
#   3. a bare "FAIL <slug>: <reason>" with no render parenthetical
cartridges: 500
  FAIL fixture-alpha: render (print, body, cadquery): FAIL — mesh is not watertight (2 open edges)
  FAIL fixture-beta: render (display, lid, preset 'tall', openscad): FAIL — geometry is identical to the fallback body
  FAIL fixture-gamma: script assigned no top-level `result`
y4d-spec check: cartridges=500 failures=3 rendered=1497 presets=612
